items.title: Add a current-story declaration surface for generated artifacts
items.context: Extend the accepted checklist or verification evidence metadata so a story can declare generated delivery artifacts with path, reason, and related intent. Prefer a narrow story-local schema instead of global ignore rules.
items.userSees: User runs `koala artifact_declare --storyId=B-cf60 --path=tests/output/bl21_lacz_ecoli_minicell/prodenovo_viewer.json --reason="BL21 lacZ minicell viewer regenerated for verification" --relatedIntent=CHK-001:happy:0` and sees stdout `✓ artifact declared: tests/output/bl21_lacz_ecoli_minicell/prodenovo_viewer.json registered for B-cf60 (related: CHK-001:happy:0)`. The file `.koala/story/actives/B-cf60/declared-artifacts.json` now exists with the registered entry. Auto-commit from B-3506 fires immediately after.

happy.desc: koala artifact_declare with valid path + reason + relatedIntent writes .koala/story/actives/B-cf60/declared-artifacts.json entry and prints success line containing the path

edge.desc: artifact_declare with the same path twice updates the entry (idempotent), not duplicate; second call output mentions overwrite

adversarial.desc: artifact_declare rejects path with * / ** / leading slash / .. components — runtime check throws explicit error (preMortem #1 anchor)

items.title: Classify declared generated artifacts separately from unexpected dirty files
items.context: Integrate declarations with the dirty ownership classifier so declared artifacts appear as declared_artifact_changes and undeclared outputs like tests/output/... remain unexpected. This story should build on B-6326 rather than duplicating classifier logic.
items.userSees: After declaring tests/output/bl21_lacz_ecoli_minicell/prodenovo_viewer.json for B-cf60, when that file is dirty in worktree, running `koala session_brief` or `koala validate --story=B-cf60 --json` shows the path under `declared_artifact_changes` category (not `unexpected_dirty_files`). Other undeclared dirty paths under tests/output/ remain `unexpected_dirty_files`.

happy.desc: After artifact_declare, classifyDirtyWorktree routes the declared path to declared_artifact_changes group (verified via koala session_brief output AND koala validate output)
DirtyWorktreeClassifierOptions.declaredArtifactPaths is populated from per-story declared-artifacts.json via store read; classifier consumers receive the merged list

edge.desc: An undeclared sibling path (e.g., tests/output/other.json) in the same worktree remains in unexpected_dirty_files — declaration is exact-match only
When no declaration exists, declared_artifact_changes group remains empty and undeclared paths land in unexpected_dirty_files (B-6326 conservative default preserved)

adversarial.desc: Declared artifact does NOT remove the path from material verification — if the artifact has materialHash drift in a referenced verificationEvidence, freshness check still flags it stale (preMortem #3 anchor)

items.title: Require evidence or delivery coverage for declared artifacts
items.context: DONE should not silently allow arbitrary generated files. Add validation that declared artifacts are referenced by verificationEvidence, delivery check, or summary so the generated output is tied to user-visible work.
items.userSees: If user runs `koala story_advance --phase=DONE --storyId=B-cf60` while declared-artifacts.json has an entry that is NOT referenced by any verificationEvidence intentRef OR delivery-check docsPromises[*].promiseId, DONE pre-check fails with row `[✗] declared artifacts referenced: 0/1 (unreferenced: tests/output/...)` and blocking error `[unreferenced_declared_artifact]`. Adding the referenced verification_evidence_add for the matching intent then unblocks DONE.

happy.desc: DONE pre-check passes when every declared artifact has a matching intentRef in verificationEvidence (the relatedIntent recorded at declare time) OR a matching promiseId in delivery-check.docsPromises

edge.desc: DONE pre-check fails with [unreferenced_declared_artifact] blocker when at least one declared artifact has no matching reference

adversarial.desc: Reference check validates the intentRef ACTUALLY EXISTS in checklist.items[*].verificationIntent[lane][index] — bogus intentRef like X-001:happy:0 does NOT pass the check (preMortem #2 anchor)
Empty declared-artifacts.json (no entries) does NOT trigger the gate — gate only fires when there is at least one entry

items.title: Add regression coverage for the BL21 lacZ viewer output path
items.context: Use tests/output/bl21_lacz_ecoli_minicell/prodenovo_viewer.json as the field-derived example: undeclared it stays unexpected; declared with evidence it moves to declared artifact category.
items.userSees: `npm --prefix packages/main run test:flow-stability-smoke` and `npm --prefix packages/main run test:validation-protocol` output `✓ passed` and include explicit assertions for the BL21 lacZ viewer path: undeclared classifies as unexpected_dirty_files; declared+referenced classifies as declared_artifact_changes; declared+unreferenced fails DONE gate.

happy.desc: Smoke: declare tests/output/bl21_lacz_ecoli_minicell/prodenovo_viewer.json with relatedIntent CHK-001:happy:0; classifyDirtyWorktree categorizes it as declared_artifact_changes
Smoke: same path WITHOUT declaration → classifyDirtyWorktree categorizes it as unexpected_dirty_files (B-6326 default behavior preserved)

edge.desc: Smoke: declared path + matching verificationEvidence entry → DONE pre-check declared-artifacts row passes
Smoke: declared path + NO matching evidence → DONE pre-check row fails with [unreferenced_declared_artifact] blocker

adversarial.desc: Smoke: artifact_declare with malicious path (containing * or ..) throws — preMortem #1 path-broadening defense
Smoke: declared+unreferenced + declared+referenced coexist; DONE gate fails (1 unreferenced is enough to block)
